Falle prima, per gravità: alte @storybook/builder-webpack5, @storybook/nextjs, webpack-dev-middleware, zod; moderate @react-email/render, @sentry/bundler-plugins, @sentry/nextjs, @sentry/webpack-plugin, editorconfig, glob, js-beautify, minimatch, resend; basse browserify-sign, create-ecdh, crypto-browserify, elliptic, node-polyfill-webpack-plugin.
